articles.title: Future security will be electronic and invisible: DRDO DG BK Das
articles.summary: The future of security is rapidly evolving towards electronic and "invisible" methods, driven by advancements like spectrum dominance, space-based systems, networked environments, and artificial intelligence. Dr. BK Das highlighted these critical technological trends that are reshaping modern security paradigms. This emphasis on advanced tech for national security is vital for SSB aspirants to understand regarding future defence strategies.

articles.title: PepsiCo is bullish on India, targets top-10 global market status
articles.summary: PepsiCo projects India will soon be a top 10 global market, driven by significant investment in its burgeoning manufacturing sector. This signals India's growing economic prowess and attractiveness for global companies, contributing to national development and job creation. Such foreign direct investment boosts the domestic economy and strengthens India's global standing, highlighting the country's potential for robust economic growth.

articles.title: Thoughts On Lanterns
articles.summary: "Thoughts On Lanterns" is a recent meme format originating from a promotional image tweet for the upcoming 2026 "Green Lantern" TV series, "Lanterns." Featuring protagonists John Stewart and Hal Jordan, the image was shared and quickly became an "exploitable" meme on social media. This pop culture phenomenon highlights how visual content from anticipated entertainment productions can rapidly evolve into widespread internet humor.

articles.title: Sagar Defence Engineering gets industrial licence to make military vessels
articles.summary: Sagar Defence Engineering Ltd, a deep-tech start-up, has been granted a crucial industrial licence by the government to manufacture surface and underwater vessels. This development signifies a major boost for India's indigenous defence manufacturing capabilities and technological self-reliance. It underscores the nation's strategic focus on strengthening its naval and maritime security infrastructure through domestic innovation.

articles.title: Su-57 jet deal, complete tech transfer on Modi-Putin meeting agenda
articles.summary: India and Russia are set to discuss the potential sale of Russia's advanced Su-57 fifth-generation fighter aircraft during an upcoming bilateral meeting between PM Narendra Modi and President Vladimir Putin. This strategic acquisition would significantly bolster India's air defence capabilities and further strengthen the long-standing defence cooperation between the two nations, indicating future military ties.

articles.title: Week 1 NFL picks, predictions for Kalshi, Polymarket, ProphetX: Rams-49ers, Packers-Vikings markets
articles.summary: The NFL's NFC West rivalry between the San Francisco 49ers and Los Angeles Rams is set to renew. This significant American football match will be played internationally in Melbourne, Australia, with kickoff scheduled for 8:35 p.m. ET. The event highlights the global reach of professional sports leagues, showcasing the global appeal of American sports.

articles.title: Avisirah Technologies’ Navi Mumbai AI data centre gets ₹75 crore funding from Syndicate Finance
articles.summary: Avisirah Technologies has secured a ₹75 crore loan facility from Syndicate Finance to fund the development of its proposed data centre and high-performance computing (HPC) facilities. This significant investment is poised to enhance India's digital infrastructure and technological capabilities, crucial for advanced data processing and supporting various national initiatives in an increasingly digital world.

articles.title: Psychology says you may keep watching a TV series you no longer enjoy for one surprisingly simple reason
articles.summary: The article opens with a relatable scenario: continuing to watch a television series for five seasons despite it becoming predictable, uninteresting, and the characters no longer engaging the viewer. This sets up an implied discussion on human habits, persistence, or decision-making in media consumption, even when enjoyment has ceased.
